units.source_text: 学校图书馆成为我唯一享乐的场所，

en.t: The school library became the only place where I found pleasure,

units.source_text: 我在这里没有读有关禅的书籍，

en.t: and there I did not read books about Zen,

units.source_text: 而是随手翻阅一些翻译小说和哲学的书。

en.t: but instead casually leafed through translated novels and books of philosophy.

units.source_text: 我有所顾忌，就不在这里列举这些作家和哲学家的名字了。

en.t: Out of certain reservations, I will not list the names of those writers and philosophers here.

units.source_text: 我多少也受到他们的影响，

en.t: I was, to some extent, influenced by them as well,

units.source_text: 我承认后来它们成为我的行为的因素，

en.t: and I admit that later they became factors in my actions,

units.source_text: 但我宁愿相信行为本身是我的独创，

en.t: but I would rather believe that the act itself was my own creation,

units.source_text: 因为我首先不愿意把我的行为归咎于接受某种既成哲学的影响。

en.t: because above all I do not want to attribute my actions to the influence of some ready-made philosophy.
